Magnesium burns in oxygen to form magnesium oxide.
The equation for the reaction is shown.
2Mg  +  O2→  2MgO
Which mass of magnesium oxide is formed when 48g of magnesium is burned?
A
20g
B
40g
C
80g
D
160g
